meta_description: The operational model of Silver & Elegant — designing algorithmically in London, handcrafting in Istanbul.

sections.label: Production
sections.title: From London Code to Istanbul Hammer
sections.body: Our design pipeline is a dual practice. Every piece starts in London, where we utilize generative design algorithms to draft and compute highly complex, organic geometries. Once the mathematical blueprint is completed, it is transmitted to our historic atelier in Kapalıçarşı, Istanbul. There, a single master craftsman brings the digital coordinates to life using the lost-wax casting technique, hand-filing, and finishing each piece with fire.

sections.label: Distribution
sections.title: Curated Global Retailers
sections.body: To preserve exclusivity and reduce waste, we work only with selected retail partners who share our appreciation for slow fashion. Our collections are available worldwide through **Wolf & Badger**, **More4id**, and **Not Just A Label**. We do not run mass distribution channels, choosing instead to deliver directly to collectors who value permanent wearable art.

sections.label: Scale
sections.title: Bespoke & Capsule Collections
sections.body: We grow deliberately and sustainably. Rather than releasing seasonal collections dictated by the traditional fashion calendar, we build small, highly conceptual capsule collections and take custom commissions. This allows us to dedicate maximum craft and attention to every single item, ensuring it meets our standard of permanence.
